# awscc_agentregistry_publisher (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::AgentRegistry::Publisher



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the Publisher was created.
- `publisher_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Publisher. The Publisher is a global resource, so the ARN has no Region.
- `status` (String) The verification status of the Publisher.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to assign to the Publisher. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the Publisher was last updated.
- `value` (Attributes) The identifier that this Publisher proves ownership of. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--value))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `value`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The fully qualified domain name (RFC 1035/1123) with at least two labels, in lowercase. The service stores domain names in lowercase, so specify the value in lowercase to avoid drift.
